current_runtime_import_contract.open_project: Workspace/OpenProject; base_revision=null; exact complete project adoption and departure decision retained.
current_runtime_import_contract.into_project: Project/IntoProject; current base_revision; task retains epoch/owner/project/input revision. Completed Task proposes only exact ModulePackages, no source project objects. Actual UI AdoptImportedDraft selects exact versions and all their companion assets; validation/conflicts complete before a new Project revision and append-only immutable library files commit. No automatic instance adoption, stock, Runs or acknowledgments.
current_runtime_import_contract.rights: Original rights remain unchanged; local import never grants public redistribution.
current_implementation_limits: No object creation or role remapping in this definition import entry; explicit category adoption remains separate.
Partial asset selection is rejected explicitly; omitted files and same-path conflicts are not silently repaired.
IntoDefinitionDraft and AddToLocalLibrary are not implemented by this increment.
